cards.text: The tabernacle is up and the altar has been dedicated. Now the LORD speaks to Moses, with a message for Aaron the priest. It's all about the seven lamps on the lampstand.

cards.question: When Aaron sets up the seven lamps, where are they supposed to throw their light?

answers.text: Onto the area in front of it

cards.question: Aaron sets up the lamps his own way, a little different from what the LORD commanded.

cards.text: Quick word about the lampstand itself. It's hammered gold from its base to its blossoms, and friend, I stand on a gold BASE and that thing STILL makes me feel underdressed.

cards.question: That golden lampstand was made to follow a pattern. Whose pattern?

answers.text: The one the LORD showed Moses

cards.text: Lamps are lit. Now the LORD speaks to Moses again, and this time it's about the Levites, one of Israel's tribes.

cards.question: Before anything else, what does the LORD tell Moses to do with the Levites?

answers.text: Move them to the camp's edge

cards.text: Here's how the cleansing goes. First, Moses sprinkles the Levites with the water of purification.

cards.question: After the sprinkling, what do the Levites do to purify themselves?

answers.text: Shave their whole bodies and wash their clothes
Fast seven days and stay inside their tents
Bathe at the river and burn their old robes

cards.text: Their WHOLE bodies, friend, so one shave and I'd lose my mustache AND my hands. Next, the Levites bring a young bull with its grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil.

cards.question: Moses is to take a second young bull, this one for a sin offering.

cards.text: Then Moses brings the Levites to the front of the Tent of Meeting. And the whole congregation of Israel gathers around.

cards.question: With all Israel gathered at the Tent of Meeting, what do the Israelites do to the Levites?

cards.text: Then Aaron presents the Levites before the LORD as a wave offering from the sons of Israel. A whole tribe, presented before the LORD, and the last time anybody presented ME, I was sitting in a bargain bin with a 25 cent sticker on my head.

cards.question: Why does Aaron present the Levites before the LORD as a wave offering?

answers.text: So they can do the LORD's service
So they can lead Israel's army
So they can judge the other tribes

cards.text: Now the Levites lay their hands on the heads of the two bulls. One is offered to the LORD as a sin offering, and the other as a burnt offering.

cards.question: The Levites offer the two bulls to the LORD to make ___ for themselves.

cards.text: Next, the Levites stand before Aaron and his sons. Then they're presented before the LORD as a wave offering.

cards.question: This is how Moses separates the Levites from the rest of Israel. What does the LORD say about the Levites?
Even after being cleansed and presented, the Levites must wait a full year before serving at the Tent of Meeting.

cards.text: Now the LORD tells Moses why the Levites are getting all this. They have been wholly given to Him from among the sons of Israel.

cards.question: The LORD says He has taken the Levites for Himself in place of whom?

cards.text: Here's the background. Every firstborn male in Israel belongs to the LORD, both man and beast.

cards.question: When did the LORD set Israel's firstborn apart for Himself?

answers.text: The day He struck Egypt's firstborn
The day He parted the Red Sea
The day He gave the Ten Commandments

cards.text: So the Levites stand in for all the firstborn of Israel. It's one crew covering every single shift, baker, and the coworkers they're covering for add up to a whole NATION.

cards.question: The LORD gives the Levites to Aaron and his sons as a gift.
The Levites serve for the Israelites at the Tent of Meeting and make atonement for them. What does that keep from coming against the Israelites when they approach the sanctuary?

cards.text: Then Moses, Aaron and the whole congregation do everything the LORD commanded with the Levites. EVERYTHING, friend, and I've had batches where I couldn't follow my OWN recipe card.

cards.question: The Levites purify themselves and wash their clothes. Who presents them as a wave offering and makes atonement to cleanse them?

cards.text: After that, the Levites go to work at the Tent of Meeting, serving in the presence of Aaron and his sons. Just the way the LORD commanded Moses.
Then the LORD has one more word for Moses about the Levites. This one's about age.

cards.question: At what age can a Levite man start the work at the Tent of Meeting?
Once a Levite starts the work at the Tent of Meeting, he keeps doing it for the rest of his life.
At fifty, a Levite stops doing the work. What can he still do at the Tent of Meeting?

answers.text: Help his brothers with their duties
Train the new priests in the law

cards.text: That's how the LORD assigns the Levites: they can assist their brothers, but they don't do the work themselves. A retirement where you still get to help, baker, and MY retirement plan was the back of a junk drawer.

findings.problem: The card says the tabernacle is up and the altar has been dedicated. Those facts come from Numbers 7 (7:1, 7:84-88), not from Numbers 8:1-2, and the card gives no reference for them.

rule.text: Facts from outside the passage are fine when they help, like who a new person is or who wrote a letter, with their reference.

findings.problem: The right answer says "in front of it," but the question never names the lampstand. "It" points back to card 1, which is no longer on screen. It could also be read as in front of the lamps. Numbers 8:2 says the lamps light the area in front of the lampstand.

rule.text: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.

findings.problem: The question opens with "This is how Moses separates the Levites." "This" points back to the steps told on earlier cards, which the baker can no longer see.

rule.text: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.

findings.problem: The joke says the firstborn the Levites stand in for "add up to a whole NATION." That's false. Numbers 8:18 says they stand in for the firstborn among the sons of Israel, not the whole nation. The joke muddies a Bible fact.

rule.text: When a moment can hold a real laugh without muddying a fact, he goes for it.

findings.problem: The question asks who presents the Levites as a wave offering. Stop 1 card 14 already told the baker that Aaron presents the Levites before the LORD as a wave offering (8:11), so the answer has been given away.

rule.text: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

findings.problem: The card repeats the answer the baker just gave on card 14 (they can assist their brothers but don't do the work). The only new part of 8:26 it adds is the closing line about assigning the Levites.
